_about: Supervisor entries of the offsite-backup add-on. install.sh --with-offsite-backup merges them into the registry (<supervisor dir>/checks.json). __CLAUDE_DIR__ and __HOME__ are filled in when the registry is read. only_if_exists: a machine without the add-on (no backup log yet) stays at 0 problems.

checks.name: Offsite backup (hourly)
checks.note: age of the last SUCCESSFUL backup (the 'done' line), not the freshness of the log - a broken backup writes to the log too (21 h of green with a dead offsite copy). Limit 150 min = two missed hourly runs; for a nightly-only schedule set MAX_MIN=1560 in the cmd.

checks.name: Offsite backup: storage size
checks.note: real size of the storage (backup-restic.sh measures it on every run) vs the free-tier cap, plus growth per day; a measurement older than 3 h is red too
